submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed no candidate exposure had a robust direct effect on species_richness after accounting for region. In single-exposure OLS with region fixed effects, the strongest signals were leaf_litter (coef=0.243, p=0.072) and slope_deg (coef=0.210, p=0.075); all others had p>0.13. In the full model with all ten exposures plus region, leaf_litter (p=0.072) and slope_deg (p=0.093) remained the only marginal candidates, and bootstrap power for both was only ~0.42. I locked leaf_litter as the single best candidate and ran the pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data: estimate=-0.046, SE=0.136, p=0.734 (n=396), which is far from significant and even flips sign. The exploratory signal did not replicate, so no exposure is confirmed to have a direct effect.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
# robust (Huber) regression per candidate with region FE
import statsmodels.api as sm
for c in cands:
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species_richness',c]).copy()
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['region']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X[c] = d[c].values
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    y = d['species_richness'].values
    m = sm.RLM(y, X, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT()).fit()
    print(f"{c:16s} robust coef={m.params[c]:8.4f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4g}")
